steps.text: November 19th, 1097, 9:20 P.M.

steps.name: Security Guard A
steps.text: This way!

steps.name: Security Guard A
steps.text: Up ahead.

steps.name: Security Guard A
steps.text: They're over there still. I think I can see her.

steps.name: Security Guard A
steps.text: Wait, didn't we just pass this road sign?

steps.name: Security Guard B
steps.text: We're back to where we were. I mean, we're running in circles.

steps.name: Security Guard B
steps.text: See, I knew it. There's something funny about the Feline's Arts.

steps.name: Security Guard A
steps.text: Calm down. The Infected community's up ahead. The thief's definitely hiding somewhere in there.

steps.name: Security Guard A
steps.text: Damned Infected... I'll find them, even if I have to flip the place upside down.

steps.name: Security Chief
steps.text: That's enough. Let's head back.

steps.name: Security Guard A
steps.text: Are you sure we should just let her go, Chief? What about the money and the merchandise?

steps.name: Security Chief
steps.text: Forget it. She didn't take that much. We'll all chip in a little and foot the bill.

steps.name: Security Chief
steps.text: The boss made it very clear he didn't want any unnecessary trouble.

steps.name: Security Chief
steps.text: Give him any more fuss, and a sacking will be the least of your worries.

steps.name: Security Chief
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Hehee~

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: You'll have to be a little smarter than that to catch a cat~

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Minnie. You there?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Miss Witch!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Here you go. Your meal and medicine for today.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Thanks!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Don't eat too fast. You mustn't choke on your food.
A slice of bread, and enough rice to stifle her hunger for the day.
When exactly did I start helping people?
And why? I had enough trouble keeping myself alive.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: *cough*... *cough*...

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Miss... You don't look too well.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Really...? Is it that obvious?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: When can I start using Originium Arts like you?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Not today~

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Huh...? But I wanna be a witch too. Like you.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Maybe once you get a bit bigger, kit.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: *cough*... *cough*...
Sharp pain.
The sharp, prickling pain of this Oripathy lesion hasn't stopped hurting for the past three months.
Maybe it's time to leave this place.
It wouldn't be nice if anyone got caught in the crystallization when it finally happens.
No, when the time comes to wave goodbye to this world, it must be done elegantly and in perfect solitude—
That's how a proper kitten and a Caster from the Witch Forest is supposed to go.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: One pub, two pubs, three pubs...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Seven kits, eight kits, nine kits...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Take a guess how many pubs and stray cats there are in this Infected block.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I know, because I counted. There are eight pubs and thirty-two stray kittens.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That's four kittens to each pub, and a fresh fin for each kitten.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Have you ever counted how many cities you've visited, how many Infected settlements you've seen?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I have. Five cities, eight settlements, and seventeen prison breaks.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I've been to many cities, but Caladon is definitely one of the more interesting ones.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Everyone's the same here. They're out to make a living when the sun goes up, and they're into the pub to drink when the sun goes down. When they close their eyes at night, they never worry about what the next day will bring.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Infected, normals. What's the difference?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Maybe one day, with a loud 'kaboom,' the whole of Caladon Bay will slip into the sea, and that'll be the wonderful end of everything~

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Which is why, if I had to pick a place to die, this wouldn't be too bad a choice.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: A place where I can look down on the whole city, and my body's turning to stone, and then, 'bang!'

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Nothing left of me, no one any the wiser. But nonetheless, I'll have to pick a place that's farther away, lest the dust drift its way down into the streets.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: The rocks in my body seem to have calmed down...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Looks like it's not yet time. At least, not today.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Until that day comes, I always have to think about where I'll find tomorrow's fun.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Oh, I didn't even notice. The sun's already up.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Good morning, Victoria. Good morning, Caladon.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: So, who's the lucky contestant who gets a visit from the kitty today?
November 23th, 1097, 10:14 P.M.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Not a soul in these buildings here... Is it how close it is to the abandoned districts?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: An old warehouse... Hm...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Maybe there's something I can use?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Let's take a peek~

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Food... There can't be food here, right?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Maybe something I can make a fiver or so from?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Whoa, whoa, that's a bit of dust. And it reeks of machine oil. Nothing quite adorable here.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: This vase looks pretty, though—
Don't touch nothin'.
I don't get it. All we're doing is kidnapping a few Infected and an old man. Why get everybody all puffed up?
Shut up. Do your job and get paid. Don't ask questions.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: (Phew...)
Counted up the weapons yet?
Lookin' good. Prob'ly overkill for a rickety old councilor.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: (Weapons? Councilor? Bo~ring...)
Keep your eyes open, though. Those goons are hired guns, I don't trust 'em.
What about the explosives? We don't need to worry about the Originium bombs?
We got guys to handle that for us. Not our department.
All we gotta do is ready the weapons and Arts Units. We're good to go in three hours.
Then we just wait at the Boil 'til they're done and pick up from there.
Who's that?!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: You hear that?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Weird... I thought I locked the doors.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: I heard it loud and clear. Someone's in here.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Someone? Where?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: No hiding in a room this small. It's probably just some cat.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Yeah, that's it. Just a cat tempting fate in here.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Let's see now... Which little kitten came pokin' her head into a place she shouldn't have?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Don't be so petty. Can't a passing stray kit take shelter here for the night?

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: An Infected? Perfect timing there.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I told you. I'm just a stray cat passing by. I wandered in here by chance alone.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Won't you overlook this if I give you this pretty vase?

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: What you heard don't matter. I don't care if you really did stumble in by accident, but now that we found you—you ain't gettin' outta here alive.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: It's curtains for you, kitten.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Haven't you heard? Bad luck befalls those who harm cats.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Missed?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: How's she still... What's with this mist—

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Hohoh, what's the rush now? How about I give you two a riddle to chew on.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: 'Why is a rock like a firework?'

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: You ain't goin' nowhere!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: This should be far enough...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Eugh... A noble's room. The smell always makes me lose my lunch.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: My shoulder... That angry lad's a fair decent shot...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: At least it didn't nick any bones...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: (Grabs the arrow's shaft)

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Um... Miss? Who might you be?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Don't move!

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Ack—

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Shh! Quiet! I don't want to kill you. I just need to hide here for a spell.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: You'd best work with me here. If you don't behave, this arrow will—

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Calm down, miss. No need to be so tense.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: You... You look hurt. Do you need any assistance?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Stay back!
The black smoke manifested by her Originium Arts spreads throughout the room. The old man takes a step backward and falls to the ground.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Sir, are you alright?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: (Nervous)

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: I'm writing my proposal. Do not disturb me until daybreak.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Very good, sir.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Miss... *cough*... *cough*...

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: If my hunch is correct, you should be an Infected.

steps.name: Old Noble
steps.text: Don't be afraid. I won't hurt you.
The elderly Savra noble suddenly grabs his chest and lets out a pained moan.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: What is it? I was just giving you a scare with my Arts.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Oh... well, there's a bother.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Someone, help! We have a man down!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: (Oh well, about time to go...)

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Something wrong, sir? I heard a girl...

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Master Angst! What happened?!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: What do we do now? Shouldn't we just kick in the door and get her?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: You stupid or somethin'? Don't you know who lives here?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: That's Councilor Angst's mansion!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Councilor? That's like a lord? Here, of all places?

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Why would a councilor live right by the Infected? And ain't this house kinda small?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Just shut your mouth. We'll figure out another way.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: There she is!

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Showin' yourself, huh? Saves us the trouble of dragging you out!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: You two... You're a pain in my rear...

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Don't even think about it!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Get her!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: She took a hit. She won't get far.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Watch her Arts, though. We don't know if they can kill, but they definitely mess with our senses.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Let's see what she's capable of—

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: It's fogging up again? She's castin'!

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: She ducked in here, huh?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: 'Green Spark...' Some kinda pub? Don't look like it.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: All these old buildings are pretty much the same. There's no way out but the way she came in. She's trapped.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Slow down. No rush.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: The Feline's got some fancy Arts. Watch the smoke. Won't be easy to catch her alive, or take her down either.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: And we don't got so much time to deal with her.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Still got those incendiaries?

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: You wanna burn the place down?

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: The buildings around here are packed pretty tight. You sure about that?

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Hurry up already! Nobody cares about the Infected. Even if it makes a scene, that's just a distraction for us.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: You think too much. Just get to it.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: We can't afford to make any mistakes here. We need her done in. Capiche?

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Gotcha.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... *cough*.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: That'll do the trick. Now let's skedaddle.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: Goddamned diseased cat... made me spend all night running around the city.

steps.name: Imposing Black-Suit
steps.text: I hear that when the Infected die, they turn to ash and explode? Never seen it for myself, though.

steps.name: Sly Black-Suit
steps.text: Don't worry about that. Let's go.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: You'll have to be smarter than that... to catch a cat.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Listen up... You didn't drive me into this corner... It's only because of my condition...
November 26th, 1097, 9:27 A.M.
Sharp pain.
Her lungs hurt, her stomach hurts, her liver hurts.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Looks like normal painkillers... don't do a thing anymore.
Stricken with pain and disease, the Feline girl looks up at the sky through the windows of the abandoned house.
A heavy fog shrouds the entire city of Caladon, to the point that the sun's radiance can no longer be seen.
From the Grey Hills to Toron, then Castshire and finally to Caladon.
I kept running, wandering the world without aim. My friends all died one by one.
And the further I got, the more I lost.
Even a dandelion caught on the wind ends up settling somewhere.
This kitty's all too tired out.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Miss Witch, are you okay?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: *cough*... *cough*...

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Is that blood?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: It looks like... this is the end.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Minnie, I have something for you...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Do you know how much these coins are worth?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Take one to Grandma Winnie every day and ask her to give you something to eat.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: And here.
The Feline witch takes out a black hat and an exquisite ring.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: (*Sigh*... The Witch's Ceremony... Not that it has much meaning left to it anymore.)

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I am Haze, the Hundred and Thirteenth Witch of the Witch Forest...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: May the Grey Hills' sages of the past bear witness to it all.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Witness the entrance of a new member to our ranks...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Witness the birth of a new soul...

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Do you remember what you asked me before?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Now you're a witch.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Really? So I can use Arts now?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Listen. You've always been able to use Arts. You have a gift for it.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: But when you use them, you need to use this ring. Just like I taught you before. Without this ring, you aren't allowed to use Originium Arts. Understand?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Also, you're only allowed to use Originium Arts on bad people. You remember how to tell bad people, don't you?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That's good...
The Feline witch stands up and struggles toward the exit.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Miss Witch? Are you leaving?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Yes... It's time for me to go...
November 27th, 1097, 3:47 A.M.
The abandoned district on the edge of Caladon. It's the quietest part of the city.
Ever since a natural disaster swept across Caladon a few years ago, this district, having fallen into disrepair, was moved to the edge of the city.
The crumbling buildings, the collapsed foundations. All of it bore witness to Caladon's history.
Gazing out from the top of the abandoned towers, there is but a vast, endless wasteland in the distance.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: If I had to pick a resting place, this might be one of the fun ones.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I knew this day would come. I can't really say it came sooner than expected, either.
The Feline witch sits against a wall in a corner and gently closes her eyes.
The sharp pain of the Oripathy lesion is starting to fade, and her body feels heavier and heavier by the moment.
Her memories flash quickly by, as though playing back before her eyes.
All her witch friends, the gentle Great Witch Grant, and the night the Victorian soldiers burned the Witch Forest by their cannon fire.
The times she spent drifting in the wastelands and the cities, the days she had to steal to get by, and all the unfair treatment she has suffered.
None of it matters anymore.
It's all coming to an end.
Yet, suddenly, she hears someone sobbing.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I can't even have my last moments to myself, can I...?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Now I know this place gets visitors.
Haze follows the wailing to another part of the abandoned tower.
In front of her, a Feline girl stands next to a window, trembling.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: (Sobs)

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Sorry... I'm sorry, Mum... I'm so sorry...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I... I don't know what to do anymore.
With a helpless, grief-stricken look, the Feline girl totters at the edge of the building.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That's very dangerous, you know?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Yagh!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Wh-Who are you...?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Nobody important.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: But I do need to tell you a few things before you jump.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: After you do it, you won't be nearly as adorable as you are now. Honestly, I can't recommend it.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Your friends will be awfully sad to see you in that state when they find you tomorrow.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Friends... Quercus...
The sobbing girl hesitates and steps back from the window.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That's better, now!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: What do I call you, little kitten?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Susie... Susie Glitter.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That's a pretty name.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: You can call me Haze.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Miss... Haze...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Miss Haze... What are you doing out here so late?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I was about to ask you the same. This is my personal, secret hideout. How did you find it?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Oh, well, I can give a cute little kit like you special permission to play about here. But not if you've come for a cordless bungee jump, however.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: *Sniffles*...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Oh, dear, what are you crying for?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: *Sigh*... It's okay. Cry all you want. No one will hear you, so no need to hold it in.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Nobody's ever around here—though there's no booze, either. It would be nice if we had some, though, wouldn't it?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: What I do have for you is free time. Come, have a talk with me?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Why were you about to do something so silly?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I... had this dream. I've had it for years...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: A years-long dream? That sounds lovely.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I... I worked so hard towards for it, years upon years...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: It was... I dedicated my whole life to it.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: And a few days ago, it was gone in the blink of an eye... Somebody destroyed all of it...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: And I don't even know why...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: None of it's left... nothing...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: How much time do us Infected get, anyway?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Someone destroyed it, you say...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: And so the first thing that came to mind was to destroy yourself too?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Seems awfully odd, doesn't it?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Huh... Huh? What do you mean?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Well, you said it yourself. Someone destroyed your beautiful dream and your life's work, but what are you doing now? Aren't you trying to destroy the very last thing you have?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: No... That's not it...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Show me your hand. Let me see it.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Huh? Huh? What are you doing?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: No crystals... It looks like you aren't too far along?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I—I don't have much idea myself...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Eep! What are you bonking me for?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: A silly kit with a muddled head. You need some sense knocked into you.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Living for a dream... That's quite the luxury for an Infected.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Most of us are just trudging along aimlessly, from one day to the next.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: 'We don't have that much longer to live. Why tire yourself out with goals and ideals?'

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: But you chose to make your dream come true, and that's impressive. There aren't a lot of people like you out there.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: But, you see... So long as you're alive, things will work out.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: You have more time than you think, not like... I digress.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: It'd be a shame to give up just like that.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: But what can I do?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I'm sure a cute little kitten like you has lots of friends.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Why don't you go talk to them? You won't get anywhere mulling over it by yourself.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: If you've lost something, find it. If someone stole something of yours, find a way to steal it back.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Give up like this, and you won't have a single thing left, you know?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: The bad ones will laugh ever harder, and that's no fair to yourself.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: It's the bad ones ruining your dreams who should be thrown off the tower, not you. Don't you think?
The young Feline looks hesitantly at the window. Her face is shrouded in helplessness. Time drifts slowly by in the pitch dark of this abandoned tower.
She spends a brief moment pondering in silence, before finally letting out a long sigh and freeing an exhausted smile. It seems the weight on her shoulders is gone.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Now, if you still feel down in the dumps, just cry it all out. Nobody's around to judge you.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: No... It's okay... Thanks...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That's more like it.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: The Great Witch says, as long as the sun rises tomorrow, there is still hope.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: As long as... there... is a...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Hum? Um?! Miss Haze, what's the matter?!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Be careful... stay away from me...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Miss Haze! What's wrong?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Go... hurry...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: What's wrong? Why is your body so hot?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Hang in there! Wake up!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Somebody! Please help!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Miss Haze... Stay with me. We... We're almost to the city...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I... I can barely carry you anymore...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: S-Sorry, I don't mean you're heavy, you're really very light, I just don't have much strength...
The girl on her back grows weaker and weaker by the minute.
She can feel a vibrant life slowly fading away.
A wet, yet warm feeling gushes onto her back and gradually spreads all over.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: This... What is this...?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Is it... blood?
Dark red blood spills from the girl's mouth and nose, dripping onto the ground.
Susie knows what this means. All Infected do.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: No... No... No...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Haze... Please... I'm begging you...
Ever since she left home five years ago, she's witnessed the passing of many Infected.
With each death she's seen, she's grown increasingly numb to them.
This is the fate that awaits all Infected.
But, for some reason, she finds herself unwilling to bear the pain of this life disappearing before her.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Please! Miss Haze... Please... No...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Hang on... We're almost there...
She sets the girl down to ease her pain.
She tightly grasps Haze's hand and tries her best to wipe away the blood on her face.
Hopeless though it may be, she tries her hardest to stall the coming of death.
Yet death draws ever nearer. It all seems to come to such a meaningless head.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Help... Help!!!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Anyone... Please...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Help me...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Help me...
Her low cries pierce through the empty night sky, echoing throughout the empty, abandoned streets.
Just then, she hears someone walking slowly towards them.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Susie...? What are you doing here?
